samples.name: construction-heap-1-ground
samples.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Create one construction-stage game sprite by editing the attached finished heap reference. Stage 1: cleared earth patch with a few sticks laid at the corners; remove all stockpiled supplies. Keep the same 32x32 logical canvas, camera, building footprint, ground anchors, pixel scale and palette. Retain transparent empty space above low construction stages; do not enlarge or recenter remaining objects. Output 1024x1024 as exactly 32x enlargement of chunky 32x32 pixels. Flat earthy colors, at most 3 shades per material. No gradients, antialiasing, halos, outlines around empty ground, text, panels or scenery. Truly transparent outside the construction site. Everything completed so far remains in this stage.
